name: orch
description: Orchestrator sessions: bind to .remember/<slug>/README.md, give the role as a message (repeated after each compaction), and at a context limit ask for a handoff, then compact when the handoff_done tool signals that it is written

rememberRoot.title: Handoff root folder
rememberRoot.description: Folder, relative to the session directory, that holds one <slug>/README.md for each orchestrator project.

limitPercent.title: Context limit (percent)
limitPercent.description: Context fill, in percent of the model window, at which the handoff and compaction sequence starts.

warnPercent.title: Context warning (percent)
warnPercent.description: Context fill at which one warning shows. The sequence arms again only after the fill drops below this value.

limitTokens.title: Context limit (tokens)
limitTokens.description: Optional token limit. 0 turns it off. When set, the sequence starts at this limit or at the percent limit, whichever comes first.

mode.title: At the limit
mode.description: auto: update the handoff and compact. ask: show a message, the person runs /orch handoff. off: do nothing at the limit.

readmeMaxLines.title: README size warning (lines)
readmeMaxLines.description: The bind output warns when the README has more lines than this.

handoffWaitMinutes.title: Wait for the handoff signal (minutes)
handoffWaitMinutes.description: How long a handoff sequence waits, after the handoff turn, for the handoff_done call (or the code in the marker file). At the limit the sequence stops with no compaction.
